user.title: Add a moOde box
user.description: moOde boxes on your network are found automatically. Use this to add one by IP address or hostname instead.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach moOde at that address. Check the IP/hostname and that the box is on.

abort.already_configured: This moOde box is already set up.
abort.not_moode: The discovered device isn't a moOde player.

zone.title: Multiroom zone
zone.description: Make **{box}** a zone sender by picking the receivers that play along with it. Leave empty if this box isn't a sender. Each receiver must have *Multiroom → Receiver* enabled in its own moOde settings.

favourites.title: Favourite stations
favourites.description: Pick the radio stations you want as one-tap favourites on **{box}**. Each one becomes a button entity (great for NSPanels and dashboards), plus a *Favourite station* dropdown. If this box is a zone sender, favourites play on the whole zone.

data.favourites_wake_zone: If no room is listening, switch the zone's rooms on when a favourite is pressed

sleep.title: Sleep timer
sleep.description: What happens when the sleep timer runs out. Fade-out only works on boxes with variable volume (it's skipped at fixed volume). A receiver's sleep timer simply takes it out of its zone.

announce.title: Announcements
announce.description: Settings for announcements (text-to-speech via `tts.speak`, or `media_player.play_media` with *announce*).

data.announce_all_rooms: Play in all rooms of the zone (switch receivers on temporarily)
data.announce_lead_in: Lead-in before speaking (seconds, lets receivers catch up)

volume.title: Volume control
volume.description: Choose *Fixed* if an amplifier controls the volume (moOde set to Fixed 0dB): the volume slider and mute are hidden. *Variable* always shows them. *Auto* guesses from MPD.

amplifier.title: Amplifier
amplifier.description: The amplifier or receiver this box is plugged into. The dashboard then shows its power, volume and input next to the box. Leave empty if there's none.

library.title: Music library
library.description: The FLACs tab on the moOde dashboard shows the music stored on this box. Artist photos are looked up on Deezer (only the artist name is sent) and kept on your Home Assistant. Without them, artists are shown with one of their album covers.

error.already_in_zone: One of the selected boxes is already a receiver in {conflict}'s zone. Remove it there first.
error.is_receiver_in_zone: {box} is itself a receiver in {conflict}'s zone, so it can't be a sender.
error.box_is_receiver: {box} is set up as a multiroom receiver in moOde. Set it to sender in moOde's Multiroom settings first.
error.not_receiver: {conflict} doesn't have the multiroom receiver enabled in moOde. Turn it on in that box's moOde Multiroom settings first.

abort.no_stations: Couldn't read radio stations from this moOde box. Check it's online.

options.zone_off: Stop and switch the zone's receivers off

options.fixed: Fixed – an amp controls the volume

box_offline.title: {box} is offline
box_offline.description: Home Assistant hasn't been able to reach the moOde box **{box}** ({host}) for over two minutes. Check that it's powered on and its network cable is connected. This warning clears itself as soon as the box answers again.

no_internet.title: {box} can't reach the internet
no_internet.description: The moOde box **{box}** ({host}) failed to open a radio stream because it couldn't connect to the station's server. Local control still works, but internet radio won't play on this box. Common causes: the box is also connected to a Wi-Fi network without internet access (turn Wi-Fi off on wired boxes), or its gateway/DNS settings are wrong (moOde → Configure → Network). This warning clears itself when the box plays a stream again.

receiver_disabled.title: {box} isn't a receiver in moOde
receiver_disabled.description: **{box}** is part of the **{zone}** zone in Home Assistant, but its multiroom receiver is disabled in moOde, so it can't play along with the zone. Enable it in that box's moOde web page (Configure → Multiroom → Receiver), or remove it from the zone under moOde Audio → {zone} → Configure → Multiroom zone.
